name: serverbot
description: Discord bot for starting and stopping game servers via systemd

scripts.clean: node -e "['dist', 'dist-tests'].forEach((d) => fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run rebuild && tsc -p tests && node --env-file=.env.test --test dist-tests/
scripts.testCommand: npm run build && tsc -p tests && node --env-file=.env.test dist-tests/run-command.js
